entities.title: Native-first examples
entities.summary: Examples organized by JavaScript's standard objects and methods: each test does a task with Date, Intl.DateTimeFormat or JSON and compares the result with UTV.
entities.purpose: One file per standard object (date.test.ts, intl-date-time-format.test.ts, json.test.ts), with a describe per method. Where the two agree, UTV supplies the expected value; where they differ, it is a literal and the doc comment says what UTV does.
boundaries: The Date tests use the UTC methods so the host's zone cannot change them; the one test about the host's zone, and the one that reads the clock, say so.
Intl.DateTimeFormat reads the host's tz database, which must know the 2026–2027 rules of New York.
